title: Help reviewing my corvex.yaml — workers won't pick up jobs

posts.author: newbie_ned
posts.body:
Server runs, dashboard works, but jobs stay `pending` forever. Here's my config (redacted the token):

```yaml
storage:
  redis:
    url: redis://localhost:6379/0
http:
  addr: 0.0.0.0:8577
workers:
  concurrency: 8
  queues: [emails]
auth:
  enabled: true
  tokens:
    - value: REDACTED
      scopes: [jobs:read, jobs:write]
```

What's wrong?

posts.author: helpful_hank
posts.body: Your workers only pull from the `emails` queue but `corvex enqueue` puts jobs on `default` unless you pass `--queue emails`. Either enqueue with `--queue emails` or add `default` to `workers.queues`. That's why they sit pending.
